info.longName: Fidelity Enhanced Large Cap Growth ETF

funds_data.description: The fund will invest at least 80% of assets in common stocks included in the Russell 1000® Growth Index, which is a market capitalization-weighted index designed to measure the performance of the large-cap growth segment of the U.S. equity market. The adviser will generally utilizing a research-driven approach identifying long-term drivers of stock returns that may include,but are not limited to, valuation, growth, quality, and other factors. The fund is non-diversified.
